name: html-linked-image-dimension-px-unit
description: A linked core/image (its wrapped in an ) serializes its width/height dimensions with the `px` unit intact, matching core's own save() output. A prior fix for responsive site fidelity introduced a `$linked` special case that stripped `px` for linked images only, producing an invalid `width:1536` declaration that both drops the width in the browser and fails Gutenberg block validation (core emits `width:1536px`).

source_reference.notes: Regression fixture for the linked-image px-stripping defect in BlockFactory::imageDimensionCssValue().

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
